description: Shell script for testing handling of empty current working directory during various git operations, including checkout, reset, merge, cherry-pick, rebase, revert, rm, apply, stash, and submodule removal.

methods.name: test_incidental_dir_removal
methods.description: Tests that incidental directory removal does not affect current working directory.

methods.name: test_required_dir_removal
methods.description: Tests that removal of directory when it is the current working directory is properly refused.

methods.name: test_incidental_untracked_dir_removal
methods.description: Tests that untracked directories are not removed incidentally.

methods.name: test_submodule_removal
methods.description: Tests removal of submodules with various git commands.
